messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating canary deploy -> staging
deploy-bot: env=staging cohort=canary-a tag=v2.14.0-canary-20260320
deploy-bot: included commits:
- 9f3b2d4 (PR #412) alice.nguyen "cache: reduce kv miss penalty" https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/commit/9f3b2d4
- 2a7c1e8 (PR #419) priya.kapoor "model-router: fallback routing for small models" https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/commit/2a7c1e8
- 6b0f4c2 (PR #424) jeffrey.hwang "runtime: batcher resume fix for timeouts" https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/commit/6b0f4c2
- 84d5a11 (PR #421) mike.ops "ci: reduce flakiness in e2e" https://github.com/redwood-inference/ci/commit/84d5a11
alice.nguyen: watching cache metrics and p95.
priya.kapoor: note that fallback routing changes sampling; will monitor quality.
qa-bot: smoke tests started against canary-a
qa-bot: smoke results: 7/8 passed — streaming-liveness failed (runtime 6b0f4c2)
jeffrey.hwang: investigating the batcher resume change now, reproducing failure locally.
mike.ops: can we continue with a note in release notes or do we need to pin? what's impact to realtime apps?
alice.nguyen: p95 token latency +20ms but within SLO; streaming-liveness failure could impact realtime customers.
priya.kapoor: recommendation: pin runtime to previous commit 5f2a8b1 for this canary. re-run smoke.
release-coordinator: agreed. @deploy-bot, apply runtime pin and restart canary cohort.
deploy-bot: applying runtime pin: runtime@5f2a8b1 -> updating tag v2.14.0-canary-20260320 (runtime-pinned)
deploy-bot: restarting cohort canary-a with pinned runtime
qa-bot: re-running smoke suite on pinned canary
qa-bot: smoke results: 8/8 passed ✅
alice.nguyen: please add note to release notes: runtime fix deferred, hotfix PR #427 tracking.
mike.ops: opening hotfix PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/427
priya.kapoor: adding monitoring bullets: streaming-liveness, p95 by model, fallback routing sample rate.
jeffrey.hwang: will draft a short follow-up if hotfix causes regressions.
release-coordinator: thread to stay open until hotfix merged. good coordination, team :thumbsup:
